overview_description.description:
Stratum is a software company that provides expert knowledge ’operations software‘ for companies that have fleets of vehicles.

Stratum’s software provides the customer with a single platform to control their business, by combining job management and fleet management, with expert knowledge and business intelligence around a central operational control centre.

Stratum’s leading edge technology enables ‘lean process’ to be added to a business. Stratum’s technology streamlines the business and removes upwards of between 15% and 20% of the common administration processes that plague companies in these sectors. 

Stratum is a platform with many different elements that can be delivered to streamline business operations e.g. Field Service mobility applications, customer web portals, fleet operations, vehicle scheduling and much more.

Stratum provides this software to international transport companies and to environmental companies. There is a wider market need, but Stratum is working on these initial markets to establish the companies’ initial customer base and footprint in the UK and Ireland.

about_short_description.short_description: Operations management software for companies with fleets of vehicles

product.name: Stratum TMS
product.description: A transport management system that centralizes order-to-invoice workflows, job planning, cost tracking, and reporting for fleet operations.

product.name: InCab Apps
product.description: Driver applications that enable real-time communication, walk-around checks, and electronic proof of delivery uploads directly to the TMS.

product.name: Stratum WMS
product.description: A warehouse management system that manages inventory, streamlines warehouse operations, and provides customer web portals for stock visibility.

product.name: Garage and Maintenance Module
product.description: A module within Stratum TMS that manages fleet maintenance processes and cost control for vehicle ownership.

product.name: Tyre Management Tool
product.description: A tool to monitor tyre inventory, improve tyre longevity, and control tyre-related costs within fleet operations.

product.name: Customer Web Portals
product.description: Web-based portals that provide customers with real-time access to stock levels, order status, and picking requests.
